module: Flowgraph module (moduleOrder 100) that synchronizes a project's actions with level loading. It lets you defer a function until loading finishes (delayOrInstantFunction) and reload the collision (be:reloadCollision) after a level loads or at the end of the tick when a prefab is loaded.
notes: The loading test is done by core_gamestate.loading(). The isLoadingLevel field is commented out and unused.
uniqueFuns is created and cleared but never used; the prefabs list is only filled.

init.desc: Creates the tables funs, uniqueFuns and prefabs, initializes the collision reload flags then calls clear().

clear.desc: Clears the tables and sets the flags reloadCollisionOnLevelLoading / reloadCollisionOnAfterTrigger back to false.

beginLoadingLevel.desc: Intended to signal the start of a level load (empty body).

finishedLevelLoading.desc: To be called at the end of level loading: reloads the collision if requested, runs then clears the deferred functions.

afterTrigger.desc: Called after the graph tick: if reloadCollisionOnAfterTrigger is true, calls be:reloadCollision().

delayOrInstantFunction.desc: Runs fun immediately if no level is loading, otherwise queues it until finishedLevelLoading.

prefabLoaded.desc: Signals that a prefab was loaded: requests a collision reload (at the end of level loading if in progress, otherwise after the tick) and stores the id.

executionStopped.desc: Called when the project stops: calls clear().
